verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a REST API with API-key/Bearer-token authentication and per-project key management (activepieces-docs-2, activepieces-docs-28, activepieces-docs-33), giving AI-native users a documented way to drive the platform programmatically, and this is further reinforced by an MCP server exposing the same platform control via natural language (activepieces-docs-4, activepieces-docs-27). Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found all common openapi paths 404) and independent/hands-on confirmation that the documented endpoints are complete and reliable.
